name: Quantum Metagloves

sources.title: MANUS Quantum Metagloves product page (Technical Specs)
sources.covers: signal latency, finger sensor type, sample rate, battery, weight, communication, wireless range

note: Finger tracking gloves. Technical Specs: "Signal latency ≤ 7.5ms" (latency_ms 7.5, an upper bound); "Finger sensor type Absolute position, 3 axis rotation"; "Sensor sample rate 120Hz"; "Battery duration Up to 3 hours (swappable batteries)"; "Weight 138 grams (including battery)"; wired "USB Type-C", wireless "Bluetooth Low Energy 5", "Wireless range Up to 15 meters"; the page describes "millimeter accurate end-point fingertip tracking sensors" without a figure (accuracy_mm null). A glove tracks the fingers; the wrist position comes from a separate tracker (the second spec block lists "Optical trackers: 2 Reflective Markers"), so the device's volume in the teleop study is that tracker's, not stated here.

workspace.quote: Not stated (the wrist is tracked by a separate system).
